description: Dulls pain and panic. Popular with people who have seen too much.

overdose.message: You take enough to stop feeling anything, which turns out to include your legs. You fold up where you stand, breathing slow and shallow, hours gone before you surface.

phases.comeup_message: A grey calm rolls in from somewhere behind your eyes. The sharp things go soft.
phases.end_message: The calm thins out. The sharp things are still there, waiting exactly where you left them.
phases.peak_message: Nothing can reach you in here. Nothing wants to. It's almost restful.

withdrawal.message: Everything is loud and close and unbearable, and the one thing that ever made it stop is not in your hand.

effects.onset_message: The edges come off everything. Whatever was urgent can wait.

name: Slow
